text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Shortage of equipment"— 
And over here, "Repairs for the common 
area"...
choice_data_list: What are you looking at?
What are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The academy's "Suggestion Box App." 
Students submit their requests and 
feedback through it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's one of the apps used by the student 
body. 
Being able to submit requests 24/7 
has made it quite popular.
choice_data_list: That sounds really convenient.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It was one of my campaign pledges 
when I ran for the student council. 
I put a lot of effort into it, right from 
the development phase.
choice_data_list:
You were involved in the development, 
too?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A little. 
Even now, whenever an update rolls around, 
I sit in on the feedback meetings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She truly is competent. 
Even outside of racing, she tackles 
everything 
concerning student life with absolute 
dedication.
choice_data_list:
(I hope she's actually getting breaks... 
right?)

(I hope she's actually getting breaks... 
right?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However... there are quite a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even if I resume after training... 
Will I finish before lights out? 
No, if I cut down on dinner time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't like meddling in student 
council business. 
I really don't, but... 
With this kind of workload—
choice_data_list: Would you mind if I helped out a bit?
Would you mind if I helped out a bit?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose I have no choice. 
Right now, I'll take any help I can get.

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
The seat here is cracked, and... 
Well, pulling the lever feels kind of off, 
or something...

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry for bothering you with something 
so minor... 
It might not even be broken enough to call 
a repair—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. Thank you for bringing it to our 
attention. 
Even the smallest annoyance 
can distract from your training.
choice_data_list:
The cable is worn down—it needs to be 
repaired!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
! Good catch. 
We'll put an out-of-order sign on this one 
and request maintenance right away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Consultation regarding a community 
participation event." 
...They want to open part of the campus to 
the public, huh? 
I support the initiative, but the details 
are lacking.
choice_data_list:
Is there anything I can work on while you 
go ask about it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Then sort through the bulletin board 
notices. 
It seems a few unauthorized postings have 
slipped in.
choice_data_list: Got it! What's next?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............ 
You're remarkably enthusiastic.
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry! Did I overstep...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'll leave it in your hands. 
I'd like you to compile a list of product 
requests for the school store.
choice_data_list: ...! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, by evening, 
the two of them had finished all the work.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, the repair team is coming as soon 
as tomorrow?" 
"Yeah! The vice president and her crew got 
right on it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove turns on her heel to leave. 
Yet, her eyes are filled with 
an unmistakable, profound warmth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That was undeniably exhausting. 
I'm going to take a break—would you care 
to join?
choice_data_list: ...Oh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm brewing black tea. 
Is the same fine with you?
choice_data_list: Ah, yes, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While sitting on the sofa and waiting... 
Air Groove suddenly opens 
a music app on her smartphone.
choice_data_list: This piece is...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, 
this is Chopin's—...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. It's out of habit from 
resting 
in my room—if it bothers you, I'll turn it 
off.
choice_data_list: No, keep it on, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As conversation lulls, the room fills 
with piano notes once more. 
Each sound falling like a gentle droplet 
of rain.
choice_data_list: Are you fond of Chopin?
Are you fond of Chopin?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
He has flamboyant and fast-paced 
compositions, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I prefer pieces like this—delicate, 
where every single note is cherished. 
I often listen to it at night, especially 
after busy days.
choice_data_list: ...So you listen to it quite a lot, then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There must be days like today when 
feedback 
suddenly floods in out of nowhere. 
Surely it's happened more than once or 
twice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose so. 
However, it is no burden.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is all—for the future of our students.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I resolved to build an academy 
where they can flourish without hindrance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Being able to dispel their concerns 
brings me genuine joy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it is precisely because I listen 
to each voice 
and refuse to neglect any detail... 
that certain truths become clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Much like this piece by Chopin playing 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Or something like that. 
Perhaps I phrased that a bit too 
poetically.
choice_data_list: ...Still, I understand what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have worked hard as well.
choice_data_list: I'd like you to keep speaking your mind.
Please keep telling me how you feel.

Can we keep listening to the music a bit 
longer?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have worked hard as well.
choice_data_list: I'd like you to keep speaking your mind.
Please keep telling me how you feel.

Can we keep listening to the music a bit 
longer?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If we are ever shorthanded again, 
perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Regardless, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For looking toward the future alongside 
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I shall consider it. Favorably.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her keep watch over the academy's 
future, 
I vowed to continue watching over her 
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, be my guest. 
Or rather, this is your room, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I should be the one asking. 
—May I rest here with you a while longer?
choice_data_list: Of course...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then, for a little while... 
...Let us remain like this.
